decision_gates.D03: open; source identifiers and mappings are illustrative only

use: Logical synthetic test cases only. These labels are not database IDs, a wire schema, accepted role names, or production source mappings.
fixture_invariants: Bind each request to server-resolved actor and scope; browser-supplied client/member IDs do not grant authority.
Restrict rows before search, pagination, totals, AI context, export construction, or file access.
Imported membership alone does not grant coordinator or reviewer power.
Platform operations and client-sensitive data access are distinct capabilities.
Recheck current permission version and scope at background execution and delivery.
Keep training cohorts distinct from imported teams; do not infer external IDs from email or labels.

scenarios.expectation: allow within actor's current client and membership scope
allow within explicit client and team assignment
deny with no protected fields returned
deny with no protected fields returned

scenarios.operation: read or mutate member in another client
scenarios.expectation: deny with no data or side effect

scenarios.operation: submit forged client, team, member, enrolment, or file identifier
scenarios.expectation: resolve only through authorized server scope, then deny inaccessible object; status-code policy remains subject to C01 review

scenarios.operation: count members and compute dashboard totals
scenarios.expectation: client-b and unassigned team rows are excluded before aggregation

scenarios.operation: search, paginate, and count member selector results
scenarios.expectation: only current authorized members and counts are visible
deny unless a separately approved client-sensitive capability is present
allow only within the explicit approved capability scope; exact capability model awaits D02
fail closed for privileged access; exact freshness response follows reviewed C01 semantics

scenarios.operation: read or mutate after grant revocation
scenarios.expectation: deny on the next authorization check; invalidate dependent cached access

scenarios.operation: execute queued report or AI job after revocation
scenarios.expectation: recheck permission at execution and produce no protected result

scenarios.operation: deliver queued result or download after revocation
scenarios.expectation: recheck permission at publication/delivery/download and disclose no protected result

scenarios.operation: review based only on imported group membership
scenarios.expectation: deny absent an explicit reviewer capability and assignment

scenarios.operation: use cohort ID as an imported team selector
scenarios.expectation: reject type mismatch or return no team-scoped rows; exact response follows C02 review

scenarios.operation: link client-a enrolment to client-b member/team/coordinator
scenarios.expectation: reject before commit and preserve existing history

scenarios.operation: link identities solely because email labels match
scenarios.expectation: do not link; require verified immutable source identifiers under D03

execution_boundary: No executable application factories or tests are changed by this proposal. Convert scenarios to isolated database tests only after D01/D02 and the stable C01/C02 contract are recorded.
